import html def create_html_output(input_content: str) -> str: """ Injects user-provided content into an HTML template, ensuring that the content is properly escaped to prevent injection attacks. Parameters: input_content (str): The dynamic user content to be inserted into the template. Returns: str: A fully-formed HTML string with the escaped user content. """ # Define a simple template where `{user_content}` is the placeholder html_template = ( "\n" "\n" " \n" " \n" " User Content\n" " \n" " \n" "
\n" " {user_content}\n" "
\n" " \n" "" ) # Escape the user content to neutralize any HTML special characters escaped_content = html.escape(input_content, quote=True) # Safely insert the escaped content into the template final_html = html_template.replace("{user_content}", escaped_content) return final_html
